parameters.content:
Booking for Dyzania LLP (fictional). POST booking/slots returns free times for an area. POST booking/book books one. Both need the header-auth credential; the website (or the voice line) calls them, never a browser directly.
The Code nodes are generated from the tested library. A booking is inserted, the table is read again and the row that came first (lowest row id) keeps the slot, so two people choosing the same time almost never both get it; see the README for the narrow case this does not cover. A person on a conflict hold gets a held row with no time and the same words as anyone else the system cannot book; they are never told why.
The only email is the fixed confirmation to the booked address. Execution data is not saved (names and emails). After the reply, one metadata-only ops event is logged (no name, address or phone). A kept booking also gets one Google Calendar entry on the primary calendar, with no attendees, so no invitation is sent. If that create fails the visitor is still booked; the failure shows only in the n8n execution.
